|notes=Set 8 was released 24 November 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The November replacement attaches to Jabba, changes the reach of activation and battle destiny, and gives a non-Jedi target at the battle. The remaster expressly requires the target to be present with Jabba. The period ruling on cancellation during activation describes the effect of the related-site generation clause. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=121 Related-site Force generation ruling]. The dated replacement survives as issuer text.
